messages:
Mia Chen: quick sync — need final decisions on Q3 launch scope, sales targets, and plg pilot owners by EOD fri. hitting infra capacity constraints if we ramp more than 3k active seats.
Noah Patel: flagged. what's the minimum launch experience we can ship without adding capacity?
Mia Chen: core MVP = chat + embeddings for search, with 2 onboarding flows (lite, standard). can we gate advanced analytics to Dedicated customers?
Li Wei: recommending gate analytics. PLG funnel focuses on activation -> 3-day DAU -> trial-to-paid. experiments: reduce friction in lite flow, add contextual hints, and an in-product upgrade CTA.
Sana Rodriguez: from field: sales are asking for regional pricing tiers and success playbooks. If analytics is gated, we need an enablement doc + 3 demo scripts. who owns those?
Noah Patel: marketing can do playbooks + demo vids. will need 2 SMEs from product and 1 from solutions. target ship in 3 weeks. :calendar:
Ajay Kumar: infra note — without commit, traffic projection > current Dedicated pool by ~40% in first 2 weeks. options: limit concurrent sessions, async queueing, or add burst-capacity. burst cost estimate ~ $12k/month.
Mia Chen: crunch the numbers vs expected revenue. small risk appetite for overprovisioning. can we stagger rollout by region?
Ajay Kumar: yes — suggest phased: NA -> EU -> APAC. each phase ~2 weeks. that halves peak by region.
Li Wei: experiments timeline: week1 A/B onboarding, week2 caching + batching config for lite flow, week3 measure activation lift. need feature flags and metric tags.
Sana Rodriguez: sales targets — initial commit: 150 enterprise opportunities, revenue goal $1.2M ARR from this cohort by EOY. is that achievable with phased rollout?
Noah Patel: seems aggressive. propose staging targets: Phase 1: 40 opps / $300k; Phase 2: 60 opps / $500k; Phase 3: 50 opps / $400k.
Mia Chen: ok, update the OKRs. also we need clear launch criteria: 1) 99th pct latency SLO under 1.2s for lite flow, 2) activation >= 18% on lite, 3) sales enablement docs + 2 demo vids ready.
Li Wei: adding monitoring: funnel dashboards, regression alerts (quality), and PLG experiment dashboard. will need events defined in analytics repo.
Noah Patel: marketing tasks: one-pager, 3 demo scripts, hero blog post, and webinar plan. assigning myself as lead, @Mia Chen as product review.
Sana Rodriguez: solutions to create 2 battlecards and 4 qualifying questions for reps. assign to @Sana Rodriguez.
Ajay Kumar: engineering action items: flag for rollout gating, deployment template for burst capacity, feature flags for experiments. ETA: 10 business days for gating + 5 days for flags.
Mia Chen: can someone post a short spec with owners + due dates? I'll sign off once owners are listed.
Noah Patel: on it — will drop doc by EOD.
launchbot: meeting created: "Q3 G2M Playbook — launch readiness" Thu 10:00am. attendees: Mia, Noah, Li, Sana, Ajay.
Li Wei: quick ask — let's prioritize one PLG metric to prevent scope creep. propose Activation (first meaningful action) at day 3.
Mia Chen: agreed. Activation day-3 is the north star for the pilot.
Sana Rodriguez: :thumbsup: will align sales scripts to highlight activation moments.
Noah Patel: cool — I’ll include the phased revenue targets and enablement checklist in the doc. expecting final signoff by Fri EOD.
